$description: LAYER 1 — BRAND. LUMI identity values, locked by the September 2026 Brand Identity Lock (Constitution Articles 12 and 20). Literal values only; a brand token references nothing. Brand tokens are never emitted as CSS variables and never consumed by components. Product state never references this layer.

gold.$description: LUMI Gold. Its jobs are the LUMI mark and the source of color.signal.attention. REALLOCATE has its own primitive and never references this token.

charcoal.$description: Charcoal. The ground of the authenticated product and of controlled marketing sections.

offWhite.$description: Off White. The ground of marketing pages and the source of light on Charcoal.

warmGray.$description: Warm Gray. The structural background step on Off White.

display.$description: Display, headlines, major titles and brand expression. Rare: never dense UI, table cells or verdict words (Constitution Article 20).

ui.$description: UI, body, navigation, forms and operational copy. The verdict word is set in this family.

data.$description: Metrics, identifiers, technical values and data-heavy contexts. Mono is a promise that a value is a measurement.
